purpose: Teach: 中絶/軍備/監理/邦人/略奪/強迫/クーデター/不起訴

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、女性社員の中絶後の復職支援を充実させろ
lines.en: I want us to expand our return-to-work support for female staff after medical leave.
lines.style: Steady, authoritative opening. Commands respect without raising volume. Measured pace. The tone of someone used to being heard and obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。軍備関連事業からの撤退を検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently evaluating our withdrawal from arms-related operations.
lines.style: Formal, respectful affirmation. Clear articulation of the update. Professional distance maintained. Steady eye contact level, neither deferential nor casual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、現場の監理体制を強化しろ
lines.style: Direct instruction. Short, clipped delivery. No softening. The weight of expectation without explanation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外邦人駐在員の安全を確保いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll ensure the safety of our overseas Japanese staff.
lines.style: Composed confirmation. Respectful formality. Delivers the commitment with quiet assurance, not hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品略奪事件にはセキュリティを強化しろ
lines.en: Tighten security in response to the product theft incidents.
lines.style: Firm, unyielding instruction. Deliberate pacing. No room for interpretation. The tone of someone addressing a problem that demands immediate action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。強迫メールへの対応マニュアルを整備します
lines.en: Yes. We'll prepare a response protocol for extortion communications.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Professional tone maintained throughout. Crisp articulation of the action item. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外クーデター時の事業継続計画を立てろ
lines.en: Develop a business continuity plan for overseas geopolitical crises.
lines.style: Authoritative, commanding. Slight emphasis on the gravity of the instruction. Measured but not hesitant. The clarity of someone thinking several moves ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。係争の不起訴処分を確認いたしました
lines.en: Understood. The non-prosecution decision on the disputed matter has been confirmed.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Formal, respectful tone. Clear and definitive. Marks the close of the briefing without lingering.
